name: Domus Cable Kit X
description: The Domus Cable Kit X. A dependable power pick with a clean, no-nonsense design and the everyday features you actually use.

specs.inTheBox: Cable Kit, Regional plug heads, Travel pouch, Warranty card

reviews.author: Tanvi B.
reviews.title: Decent but not perfect
reviews.body: Took a while to get used to this one. The finish scuffs more easily than I would like. Close enough to the listing description. Still, I am keeping it.

reviews.author: Rohan R.
reviews.title: Worth every rupee
reviews.body: Picked it up on a whim and it has earned its place. Build quality is genuinely good for the price. Second Domus product I own and both have lasted. No regrets.

reviews.author: Siddharth H.
reviews.title: Would buy again
reviews.body: Bought this after returning two other brands. Setup took under ten minutes with no surprises. Matches the listing description exactly. No regrets.

reviews.author: Gaurav B.
reviews.title: Exactly what I wanted
reviews.body: Replaced a five-year-old unit with this. Nothing has rattled loose or started creaking yet. Domus seem to have got this one right. Happy to recommend it.

reviews.author: Nikhil P.
reviews.title: Exactly what I wanted
reviews.body: Bought this after returning two other brands. It does the one job it advertises and does it well. Second Domus product I own and both have lasted. No regrets.

reviews.author: Devansh R.
reviews.title: No complaints at all
reviews.body: Replaced a five-year-old unit with this. Setup took under ten minutes with no surprises. Matches the listing description exactly. No regrets.

reviews.author: Priya D.
reviews.title: Okay once you adjust
reviews.body: It is fine, but I expected slightly more. The finish scuffs more easily than I would like. About what I expected at this price. Good value, not a standout.
